name: idempotent-request
documentation: Answers a repeated request with the stored answer: the request id (x-ms-client-request-id) is the key in the platform's distributed cache.

input.title: PaymentRequest
input.documentation: Starts idempotent-request with a PaymentRequest; the request carries the header x-ms-client-request-id.

steps.name: read the request id
steps.note: x-ms-client-request-id names the request: a retry after a lost response carries the same id. Without it the request is refused.

steps.name: look for the stored answer
steps.note: The platform's distributed cache is shared by every instance on the stand: a retry finds the answer whichever instance served the first call.

steps.name: answered before?
steps.note: yes: the stored answer goes back unchanged, the work is not done again.

steps.name: answer as before
accept the payment
store the answer
steps.note: Kept for cacheSeconds from the configuration Flow; after that the same id is a new request.

Ev_End.name: answered and stored
Ev_End.title: ADDED
Ev_End.documentation: Success, HTTP 200: the work is done, the answer is stored; cacheStatus Added.

Ev_Replayed.name: answered from the cache
Ev_Replayed.title: IS_COMPLETED
Ev_Replayed.documentation: Success, HTTP 200: a repeated request id; the stored answer, cacheStatus IsCompleted.

failure.title: NO_REQUEST_ID
failure.documentation: Failure, HTTP 500: no x-ms-client-request-id; the message is in the caller's language.
